paper.title: Anytime Model Selection in Linear Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Online model selection in linearly parametrizable bandits
unmapped: Reward is linear in an unknown feature map from a class of M candidate feature maps phi_j: R^{d0} -> R^d; at least one map j* represents the reward (model selection over M models)
Image of each phi_j spans R^d and no two feature maps are linearly dependent
Learner must use an exploration distribution pi maximizing the minimum eigenvalue C_min of the feature covariance
settings.definition_quote: At step $t$ the learner selects an action $\vx_t \in \calX$, where $\calX \subset \sR^{d_0}$ is a compact domain and observes a noisy reward $y_t = r(\vx_t) + \varepsilon_t$ such that $\varepsilon_t$ is an i.i.d.~zero-mean sub-Gaussian variable with parameter $\sigma^2$. We assume the reward function $r$ is linearly parametrizable by some unknown feature map, and that the model class $\{\vphi_j\}$ contains the set of plausible feature maps ... there exists $j^\star \in [M]$ such that $r(\cdot) = \vtheta^\top_{j^\star} \vphi_{j^\star}(\cdot)$.

algorithms.name: ALExp (Anytime Exponential weighting algorithm based on Lasso reward estimates)

symbols.C_min: max over pi of the minimum eigenvalue of E_{x~pi} phi(x)phi(x)^T
symbols.C_M: C(M,delta,d) = sqrt(1 + log(M/delta) + (log log d)_+ + sqrt(d(log(M/delta) + (log log d)_+)))

conditions: oracle agent j* uses UCB or Greedy policy; other agents arbitrary

source.label: thm:regret_main
source.quote: Then \alexp satisfies the cumulative regret R(n) = O(n^{3/4}B + n^{3/4}C(M,\delta,d) + \cmin^{-1}\sqrt{n} C(M,\delta,d)\log M + \cmin^{-1/2}n^{5/8}\sqrt{d\log(n) + \log(1/\delta)}) simultaneously for all $n \geq 1$, with probability greater than $1-\delta$.

results.notes: Informal theorem; only fastest-growing terms. B mapped to S. Regret is realized sum r(x*)-r(x_t) bounded w.p. 1-delta.

bound.expression: S*T**(3/4) + sqrt(T)*sigma*C_M*log(M)/C_min + S**2*C_min*sqrt(T) + S*sqrt(T*(log(log(T*S**2)) + log(1/delta))) + (1 + T**(-3/8)*sqrt(log(M*d/delta) + log(log(T)))/C_min)*(S*T**(1/4) + (T**(3/4) + log(T)/C_min)*sigma*C_M + T**(5/8)*sqrt(d*log(T) + log(1/delta) + S**2)/sqrt(C_min))
bound.expression_latex: C_1Bn^{3/4} + C_2 \sqrt{n} \cmin^{-1} C(M, \delta, d)\log M + C_3 B^2\cmin\sqrt{n} + C_4 B\sqrt{ n( (\log \log nB^2)_+ + \log(1/\delta))} + C_5 (1+\cmin^{-1}n^{-3/8}\sqrt{\log(Md/\delta) + (\log\log n)_+} ) [ Bn^{1/4} + (n^{3/4} + \frac{\log n}{\cmin})C(M, \delta, d)+ \frac{n^{5/8}}{\sqrt{\cmin}}\sqrt{d\log n + \log(1/\delta) + B^2}]

symbols.C_min: max over pi of the minimum eigenvalue of E_{x~pi} phi(x)phi(x)^T
symbols.C_M: sqrt(1 + sqrt(d(log(M/delta) + (log log d)_+)) + log(M/delta) + (log log d)_+); C(M,delta,d) = C_6 sigma C_M

conditions: oracle agent j* uses UCB or Greedy policy

source.label: thm:main_regret_rigorous
source.quote: then exists absolute constants $C_1, \dots, C_6$ for which \algo attains the regret R(n) \leq C_1Bn^{3/4} + C_2 \sqrt{n} \cmin^{-1} C(M, \delta, d)\log M + C_3 B^2\cmin\sqrt{n} + ... with probability greater than $1-\delta$, simultaneously for all $n \geq 1$.

results.notes: Absolute constants C_1..C_6 unspecified, so recorded as O. Log log terms written without (.)_+.

bound.expression: S*T**(3/4) + sqrt(T)*C_M*log(M) + S**2*sqrt(T) + S*sqrt(T*(log(log(T*S**2)) + log(1/delta))) + (T**(3/4) + log(T))*C_M + T**(5/8)*sqrt(d*log(T) + log(1/delta) + S**2)
bound.expression_latex: Bn^{3/4} + \sqrt{n} C(M, \delta, d)\log M + B^2 \sqrt{n} + B\sqrt{ n( (\log \log nB^2)_+ + \log(1/\delta))} +(n^{3/4} + \log n )C(M, \delta, d)+ n^{5/8}\sqrt{d\log n + \log(1/\delta) + B^2}

symbols.C_M: C(M,delta,d) = sqrt(1 + sqrt(d(log(M/delta)+(log log d)_+)) + log(M/delta) + (log log d)_+)

conditions: feature maps phi_j: X -> R chosen from an orthogonal basis of L^2(X) with ||phi_i||_{L^2}/Vol(X) >= 1
oracle agent uses UCB or Greedy policy

source.label: cor:alexp_unif
source.quote: then \algo with uniform exploration $\pi = \mathrm{Unif}(\calX)$ attains the regret R(n) = O( Bn^{3/4} + \sqrt{n} C(M, \delta, d)\log M + B^2 \sqrt{n} + B\sqrt{ n( (\log \log nB^2)_+ + \log(1/\delta))} +(n^{3/4} + \log n )C(M, \delta, d)+ n^{5/8}\sqrt{d\log n + \log(1/\delta) + B^2}) with probability greater than $1-\delta$, simultaneously for all $n \geq 1$.

results.notes: Independent of C_min; scalar feature maps (d=1 per map in the statement although d still appears).
